title: Use the skeletal-mesh facing basis for Pose Search while preserving world velocity
e74_e75_falsification: Rotating world velocity into animation axes was incorrect and caused all-idle search. Pose Search expects world trajectory vectors plus the correct world-facing basis; it performs the local frame comparison internally.
hypothesis: The trajectory facing was sourced from the actor rather than the skeletal mesh. Using the mesh's world facing for current trajectory state and applying the same actor-to-mesh relative rotation to desired actor facing will make forward shell motion select Walk_Fwd without changing world velocity, path, or live pose history.
single_behavior_change: Pose Search current facing becomes the skeletal mesh world rotation when a mesh exists. Desired facing becomes desired actor-world facing composed with the existing actor-to-mesh relative rotation. Current/future velocity and positions remain unchanged world-space values. Components without a mesh retain actor facing.
tdd_contract: Actor yaw 0 and mesh yaw -90 resolve current Pose Search facing yaw -90.
With unchanged world velocity +X, inverse mesh-facing maps velocity to authored local +Y.
Actor yaw 30 and mesh yaw -60 preserve the same actor-to-mesh -90 offset; actor-forward world yaw 30 localizes to authored +Y.
Desired actor yaw 30 resolves desired Pose Search facing yaw -60.
Velocity magnitude and exact zero velocity are unchanged.
All locomotion and standing contracts remain green.
Authoritative Normal selects MF_Unarmed_Walk_Fwd during sustained forward movement without asset-name intervention.
Normal physical root has positive route-projected progress, exceeds ZeroActions, finishes closer to the shell than ZeroActions, preserves support/readback, and returns to BalanceActive_Standing.
rejection_rule: Reject and revert if Walk_Fwd is not selected during sustained movement, route-projected physical progress is nonpositive, Normal tracking is not better than ZeroActions, or any standing/stop/support contract regresses.
next_if_supported: Run matched Normal and ZeroActions measurements, then preregister and execute immutable scripted-locomotion protocol v2 with full negative controls and repetitions.
